item.title: Gambit 0.1.3
item.description:
# Gambit 0.1.3
Released September 18, 2026.
## Tab UX hotfix
- Removed automatic and arbitrary tab grouping. - Removed collapsed tab stacks and dynamic hover resizing. - Restored a stable creation-order tab strip with predictable fixed widths. - Kept a subtle hover treatment and one clear active-tab indicator. - Preserved native macOS tab context menus for Duplicate, Mute/Unmute, and Close.
This hotfix supersedes Gambit 0.1.2 in the Sparkle update feed.
